sessions.label: Practice 1
narrative: Max Verstappen set the pace in Practice 1 with a 1:37.520.

Franco Colapinto left the most time on the table: their fastest lap (1:40.531) was 0.153s slower than the theoretical lap built from their own best sectors (1:40.378), so there is more pace in the car than the lap time shows.
Valtteri Bottas had the highest speed-trap reading, 334.0 km/h.

Quickest credible clean average by compound: Lando Norris SOFT 104.231s (6 laps, medium confidence); Oscar Piastri MEDIUM 104.412s (6 laps, medium confidence). Fuel loads and run plans are unknown, so this is not a definitive race-pace ranking.
The deepest credible sequence was Max Verstappen's SOFT run: 10 retained laps at 105.204s average, with a net +0.082s/lap trend.
